about_the_game:
SILIVRI CITY – CAPITAL OF CHAOS

A city where logic has ended, and even humor says, “This is too much for me.”
Now you’re free — nothing is mandatory in Silivri City.
Join protests, fake a diploma, or do absolutely nothing.
Just grab your car and enjoy the madness.

🤝 WRITE YOUR OWN STORY — CO-OP SYSTEM

Play with up to 3 players in online co-op mode.
Complete missions together, or scam your friends.
Will you cooperate… or take the first step toward betrayal?
The choice is yours.

🧩 OPTIONAL MISSIONS – NO ONE FORCES YOU

In Silivri, no one tells you what to do.
You choose the missions — and live with the consequences.

  • DiplomAli & Belge Kenan: Get into the fake diploma business and print counterfeit certificates.

  • Imamson, Miscord, Doblox & Faltay: Find this quartet; jail them or let them go — the “lawless” mission is in your hands.

  • Budget Bekir: Collect taxes from the city and deliver them to the palace — run the economy your way.

  • Illegal Migrants: Take them to the border — help them or turn it into profit.

  • Six-Chair Group: Do the opposite of what they say and watch the chaos unfold.

  • Hayri the Helper: Deliver aid crates to the ship heading for Gaza.

  • Tentmaster Tuncay: Produce tents, sell them in the park, and break the market.

  • Protest Park: Help clean up trash among protesters.

Every mission is another version of the city’s absurdity.

🌍 OPEN WORLD – TOTAL FREEDOM

Silivri is a semi-living city filled with strange places and NPCs that’ll make you say, “What the hell?”
Day–night cycles, random encounters, and a world that doesn’t care about logic.

  • Black Money Forest: Hunt down Dolat, MAPARACI, and 100xDede to earn dirty cash.

  • Powder Sugar Factory: If you love production, manufacture and sell the forbidden “powder.”

  • Smuggler Route: Collect migrants and send them to the border by bus.

  • Influencer Hunt: Meet random internet stars wandering in the villages.

  • Mountain Bandits: At night, gunfights may erupt — there’s no safety here.

No mission is required. No logic is permanent.
It’s just you and the city.

💰 ECONOMY & MONEY LAUNDERING

Making money in Silivri isn’t easy — especially the legal kind.
Launder your black cash at the Beauty & Tax Evasion Salon,
then spend it however you want:

  • ÖTV Automotive: Buy any car you like.

  • Illegal Arms Dealer: Frying pan, axe, pistol — whatever you need.

  • Tool Shop: Get shovels, pickaxes, and building tools.

  • Public Bread & Döner Shops: Satisfy your hunger and thirst.

  • “Three-Letter” Market: Drinks, snacks, and survival with humor.

🏠 BUILD YOUR OWN LAND – CONSTRUCTION SYSTEM

You start in an illegal plot of land.
Buy building materials from the Black Sea contractor,
expand your area, and build storage or new structures.

Find fuel, refill your car, and head into the city —
because even the smartest move will look stupid here.

⚙️ FEATURES

🔹 Full open-world sandbox — no mandatory missions, total freedom.
🔹 Online co-op (1–3 players) — teamwork or betrayal, you decide.
🔹 Absurd NPCs, unique characters, and random events.
🔹 Black money economy & laundering system.
🔹 Vehicles, fuel, building, crafting, hunger & thirst mechanics.
🔹 Real city culture + dark humor = unforgettable chaos.

Silivri City: Not just a city — a parody universe.

short_description: Silivri City is an open-world co-op game blending absurdity with dark humor! Take on missions, launder money, jump in a car, explore the city — or betray your friends. Every NPC has a story. Will you save Imamson, Miscord, Peypal, and Doblox… or send them straight to prison? The choice is yours!
